reason: The cited evidence (E1, E2) demonstrates precipitation strengthening by coherent L12 nanoprecipitates in a different HEA system (Al0.7CoCrFeNi), but does not provide any evidence for Ti-rich precipitate formation, mechanical enhancement, or caloric property retention in the MM'X-based (MnNiSi)0.62(FeCoGe)0.38 alloy. The key premises about Ti-specific effects and caloric response are unsupported.
premises: Ti microalloying (1–2 at%) in (MnNiSi)0.62(FeCoGe)0.38 will form coherent nanoscale Ti-rich precipitates upon annealing
These precipitates will increase compressive strength by 20–50% and improve crack resistance
The nanoscale, coherent precipitates will not degrade the caloric phase transformation or response
Precipitation strengthening via coherent nanoprecipitates is effective in high-entropy alloys
